Hello,

I would like to change the default value of the lower and upper whiskers in a boxplot (from lower/upper hinge -/+ 1.5 * IQR to quantile 0.1 and 0.9).

Is there an easy way ? Or must I write my own stat_boxplot ?

Thank you very much.

On Mon, Jun 8, 2009 at 10:39 AM, David Hajage<dhaj...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hello,
>
> I would like to change the default value of the lower and upper whiskers in
> a boxplot (from lower/upper hinge -/+ 1.5 * IQR to quantile 0.1 and 0.9).
>
> Is there an easy way ? Or must I write my own stat_boxplot ?

There is no easy way, basically because I'm of the strong believe that
that is not a boxplot. I agree it's a useful plot in some
circumstances, but I think it's misleading to display it in the same
way as a boxplot.

An alternative would be this:

d1 <- function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.1))
d9 <- function(x) unname(quantile(x, 0.9))

ggplot(mpg, aes(model, cty)) +
geom_crossbar(stat = "summary", fun.y = median, fun.ymin = d1,
fun.ymax = d9) +
geom_point() +
coord_flip()
